features: EMA20 and EMA200 ewm adjust false; RSI2 Wilder smoothed (EMA alpha1/2) close delta; ATR14 Wilder alpha1/14 for TR max(H-L,abs(H-prevC),abs(L-prevC)). Past complete bars only.
fill: next bar open; stop=entry-1.5*ATR14(t), target=entry+3.0*ATR14(t), stop first on same bar, unfavorable stop gap at next open, favorable target gap capped at target
open_end: censor, do not force time exit at partition boundary
signal: After >=240 complete warmup hours: EMA200(current)>EMA200(t-24), close(t)>EMA200(t), close(t)<EMA20(t), RSI2(t)<=10
